id: # meshtrig: the device mesher stopped a pixel-policy training run (render: the device mesher could not mesh section 8 4 17 pass 0 (error 1))

field: device mesh (section pass vertices; error 1, MESHING_ERR_TRIG)
cause: meshing_count_start returned at once for a launch with no requests, so the feeds in it never had their staging uploaded or their band and chunk copies run; a launch has none when every section pass in it is served by another env's shared mesh (cuda/render mesh_begin, render_mesh_share 1: the product's path at N 256, never with --device-mesh 2 or the gates' dumps, which carry no keys). The feed's sequence number went on and the view's shadow recorded the bands as sent, so the env's device world kept the bands before them: its later meshes were drawn from that stale world (stale pixels), and a sunflower head no longer in the env's world (175:8 at 221 64 267, section 13 4 16, renderer slot 40 in pipe_bench's speedrun corpus at N 256, --env-base 768, configs as the run's) asked for cos(6.0463073783505009e18), a key the request no longer listed (the training run's section 8 4 17 is the same error on the same path, not replayed). Now the copies of a launch without requests are uploaded and run (and waited for before its staging is reused); a pass the device still cannot mesh is meshed by the C mesher on the host from the device's copy of its world
pin: cuda/render/gate.sh --twin (render_check --twin: twin slots end with the same bands)
